items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I'm sorry, Walsh. You're talking about a dream band?

ctx.x: This down right here. That's the volume control. I'm sorry, Walsh. You're talking about a dream band?
I'm just killing all that. I don't know the fellas' band, but when I played in Vienna, they had a band for these guys. They were very good positions. Vienna put on some of the best positions.
